Explain.SourceString: 累计在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，整场比赛的任意一个小局中，安放的爆破物击败至少3名敌人
Explain.LocalizedString: Defeat at least 3 enemies with explosives in any round of a Demolition/Ranked match

Details.SourceString: 【……然后把你们都送上天！】
Details.LocalizedString: "...and I'll blast you all away!"

Explain.SourceString: 累计在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，用一枚战术道具击倒或击败至少3名对手
Explain.LocalizedString: Use a Tactical Item to defeat or knock down at least 3 enemies in Demolition/Ranked matches

Details.SourceString: 【我不喜欢争斗，但如果和其他人发生争斗，我会赢！】
Details.LocalizedString: "I don't like fighting, but if you insist, I'll destroy you."

Explain.SourceString: 累计在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，在自己被敌人致盲期间，击败 {0} 名对手
Explain.LocalizedString: Defeat {0} enemies while blinded in Demolition/Ranked matches

Details.SourceString: 【眼中无枪，心中有枪。】
Details.LocalizedString: "Do not aim with your eyes. Aim with your heart."

Explain.SourceString: 累计在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，整场比赛的任意一个小局中，己方仅自己存活且敌方全部存活时，获得胜利
Explain.LocalizedString: Win any single round of a Demolition/Ranked match after you become the sole survivor of your team with all enemies remaining

Details.SourceString: 【卡丘人每次濒死时都会变得更强大……开玩笑的，没这种事。】
Details.LocalizedString: "They say whatever doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Hah! It doesn't."

Explain.SourceString: 在团队乱斗的匹配比赛中，至少击倒敌方 30 人
Explain.LocalizedString: Knock down at least 30 enemies in Team Deathmatch

Details.SourceString: 【还有王法吗！还有法律吗！】
Details.LocalizedString: "Is there no justice? No law?"

Explain.SourceString: 在团队乱斗的匹配比赛中，15秒内击倒至少5个对手
Explain.LocalizedString: Knock down 5 enemies in 15s in Team Deathmatch

Details.SourceString: 【横冲直撞，无人能挡！】
Details.LocalizedString: I am Death, the destroyer of worlds!

Explain.SourceString: 在团队乱斗的匹配比赛中，自己被击败前，击败至少10名对手
Explain.LocalizedString: Defeat at least 10 opponents before getting defeated in Team Deathmatch

Details.SourceString: 【我走过了，你们倒下了。】
Details.LocalizedString: ”I've passed through, and you've fallen.“

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，落后7局后，获得最后对战胜利
Explain.LocalizedString: Win after trailing by 7 rounds in a Demolition/Ranked match

Details.SourceString: 【胜利是对坚守者最好的奖赏。】
Details.LocalizedString: Victory is the best reward for those who persevere.

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，剩余1点生命值时赢得该回合胜利
Explain.LocalizedString: Win a round in Demolition/Ranked match with 1 HP remaining.

Details.SourceString: 【运气，也是实力的一部分。】
Details.LocalizedString: Luck is part of skill too.

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，单回合扶起队友 达到4次
Explain.LocalizedString: Revive teammates 4 times in a single round of Demolition/Ranked match

Details.SourceString: 【不客气，这是我应该做的。/你帮我，我帮你，我们把把在一起~】
Details.LocalizedString: You're welcome. It's what I'm here for. You'll help me, I'll help you. We're in this together!

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，在一回合中受到5名不同对手的攻击伤害但成功存活下来
Explain.LocalizedString: Survive attacks from 5 different opponents in a single round of a Demolition/Ranked match

Details.SourceString: 【你们五个一起上，我在赶时间。】
Details.LocalizedString: Come at me, I've got no time to spare.

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，被击倒或击败的同时，（包括道具或召唤物击败）击倒或击败正在攻击你的对手
Explain.LocalizedString: In Demolition/Ranked matches, knock down or defeat the opponent attacking you at the moment of your knockdown or defeat (including by items or summons).

Details.SourceString: 【打了我还想跑？】
Details.LocalizedString: Think you can run?

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，击倒或击败处于空中飘飞状态的对手
Explain.LocalizedString: Defeat or knock down gliding enemies in Demolition/Ranked matches

Details.SourceString: 【你给我下来！】
Details.LocalizedString: Get down here!

Explain.SourceString: 在一般爆破/排位爆破的匹配比赛中，使用狙击枪类型的武器一击爆头击倒或击败弦化状态的敌人
Explain.LocalizedString: Use a sniper rifle to achieve a one-shot headshot, knocking down or defeating an enemy in a stringified state during Demolition/Ranked matches.

Details.SourceString: 【弦化虽好，但我技高一筹~】
Details.LocalizedString: Stringification is impressive, but I'm simply superior!
